16 August, 2025
DC Water Advises Public of Unexpected Sewer Overflow from Anacostia Force Main Under Repair

DC Water is advising the public of a Sanitary Sewer Overflow (SSO) that occurred early this morning, while performing ongoing repairs on the Anacostia Force Main in Northeast DC.

27 July, 2025
Proactive Notification of Possible Controlled Emergency Sewage Overflow into Beaverdam Creek and Anacostia River

There is the potential for a controlled emergency sewage overflow as early as this evening. Signs will be posted warning residents to avoid contact for up to 30 days if the overflow occurs.

21 July, 2025
PUBLIC NOTICE: DC Water Advises Public of Sewer Overflow in Northeast DC

DC Water is advising the public of a Sanitary Sewer Overflow (SSO) on a street in Northeast DC at the entrance to a park. A 108-inch sanitary sewer line failed overnight. While initially contained, an overflow of diluted untreated wastewater began coming from the collapsed pipe today.

Wastewater periodically continues to overflow from the broken main, with approximately 6,200 gallons of sewer overflows so far.

1 July, 2025
UPDATE: No Issues Found with Sewer Line After Sinkhole Discovered on Ramp

DC Water has completed testing of a major sewer line. The ramp remains closed pending further assessment.
